title: Chromatic count factors over connected components
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph and $k$ a natural number, and write $\pi_k(G)$ for the number of proper $k$-colourings of $G$. Then
\[
  \pi_k(G) = \prod_{C} \pi_k\bigl(G[C]\bigr),
\]
where the product ranges over the connected components $C$ of $G$ and $G[C]$ denotes the subgraph of $G$ induced on the vertex set of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: product over the connected components of G
each factor is the k-colouring count of the induced subgraph on a component's vertex set
